text:
Maya: Quick sync — were promoting the May product benchmark webinar (EMEA friendly time slot). Need a multi-format social push: X thread, LinkedIn carousel, and targeted sponsored posts. Also want a small influencer seeding list. Who can take what?

Connor: Ill do LinkedIn carousel copy + carousel frames. Plan: 6 cards (problem, approach, benchmark stat, visual chart, CTA, speaker slide). Need data viz from research + two short quotes.

Priya: Ill own the X thread + scheduling. Suggest 4-part thread (hook, stat card, micro-case, CTA). Will A/B test two hooks: ops pain vs cost saving.

Ben: Ads Bot can spin up sponsored sets. I'll need target specs: geo (US/EMEA), titles (SRE, ML Eng, Platform), company size 50+. Budget ask? Recommend $1.5k pre-webinar + $2k retarget.

Zoe: Ill coordinate influencer seed — 6 ppl (infra dev advocates). Short ask: 1 tweet + 1 LI repost + link to registration. Offer panel access + exclusive slide deck. Need outreach copy.

Maya: Measurement: registrations, CTR, CPL, and post-webinar demo requests. Primary KPI = registrations from X/LI (goal 800). Secondary = top-50 eng leads.

Priya: Timing: Post X at 08:00 BST / 3:00 PT, LinkedIn carousel at 08:30 BST. Sponsored to start 48h before. Live webinar 11:00 BST. Dry run 24h prior.

Connor: Assets needed from design: carousel frames (1080x1080), stat card (1200x675), thumbnail for recording. Export tags: carousel_v1, statcard_v1, thumb_v1. Please drop in #design-handoff.

Ben: Targeting snippet for Ads team (copy for automation):
```
geo: [US, UK, DE, FR]
titles_include: ["SRE", "Site Reliability Engineer", "ML Engineer", "Infrastructure Engineer", "Platform Engineer"]
company_size: [50-5000]
exclude_segments: [existing_customers, demo_requested_last_90d]
bid_strategy: maximize_clicks
daily_budget: 200
```

Zoe: Outreach template for seeds (short): "Hey <name>! Were hosting a benchmarks webinar showing latency & cost wins with caching + batching. Would love your take + a quick share if its relevant. Well share slides & access. Thx — Zoe (Redwood)"

Maya: Legal check: can we run the stat "~40% avg token cost reduction"? Research said 35-45% depending on workload. Legal needs qualifier "internal benchmark, varies by workload." Priya add to copy.

Priya: Noted. All copy will include: (internal benchmark, sample workloads in blog). Also will add link to methodology in carousel final card.

Connor: For carousel CTA lines: Variant A: "See the numbers -> register"; Variant B: "How we cut token cost by ~40% (internal)" -> register. We can test which drives better reg CTR.

Ben: Budget & channels approved: $3.5k total. Will split 60/40 between LI/X. Retarget on-site visitors who view >50% of the landing page for 7 days.

Zoe: Seed list asked: drop names by EOD. Ill DM each with unique note + request for share. Mark any declines.

Maya: Inbound routing rules (for HubSpot pipeline):
```
if job_title matches (SRE|ML|Platform|Infra) OR company_size >= 200:
  score += 40
if utm_source in (x, linkedin):
  score += 10
if attended_live:
  score += 50
if score >= 80:
  owner = SDRs_high_intent
elif score >= 50:
  owner = SDRs_warm
else:
  owner = nurture_automation
```

Priya: Engagement play during live: 2 people on replies (one product, one community), 1 person on DMs, 1 on speaker prompts. Sam? (not in thread) if youre available.

Connor: Can design also export a GIF snippet from the recording? Well use for paid + stories. Request: 15s clip, loopable.

Ben: Reporting cadence: ad performance daily, registrations hourly in last 24h before event. Post-webinar: export attendees -> match to HubSpot -> create top-50 list for SDRs.

Zoe: Also ask — can we offer exclusive follow-up 1:1 slots for top-50? Ill coordinate calendar links. Good enticement.

Maya: Yes, top-50 get 20min slot with product/solutions. SDRs will prioritize. Zoe coordinate scheduling link and pass to Liam.

Priya: Draft timeline + owners:
- Today: seed list + audience spec (Zoe/Ben)
- Tomorrow: Figma frames in #design-handoff (Connor)
- 48h before: Sponsored live (Ben)
- 24h before: dry run + capture GIFs (All)
- Day-of: reply squad live (Priya + volunteers)

Maya: Final ask: drop your :+1: when you can meet deadlines. Also ping me if blocked on data viz.

RSVP Bot: Webinar page published (draft) -> https://rwd.in/webinars/benchmarks-2026 (publishing pending)

Ads Bot: Campaigns created (draft). IDs: LI-9423, X-8811. Share ad copy once Connor finalizes the stat line.
